dedupe_keys.name: bandung aquaponic pond iot water quality measurements 2023

description: This dataset records pH, total dissolved solids and water temperature in a small aquaponic installation at Bina Nusantara University in Bandung, Indonesia. The team uses an ESP8266 controller and immersed sensors in a one-cubic-metre pond holding approximately seven hundred litres, connected to a nutrient-film hydroponic system. Measurements cover January–March 2023; repository metadata describe 118,286 rows and five columns. Mendeley version 2 provides raw-labelled and filtered CSV files free under CC BY 4.0. The filtered series retains recommended ranges for pH, dissolved solids and temperature, which limits its use for identifying adverse conditions. The short metadata do not establish a uniform sampling interval. A reviewer-assessed use is testing sensor-based water-management or small urban-food-production scenarios. model-citydrain3-integrated-urban-drainage-toolbox offers related water-flow modelling at a different scale, without a verified aquaponics component. No sensor data, filter implementation or control algorithm was executed.
